meaning: Refuting the weaker reading by the irrelevant-respect objection does not refute the strong-reading First Way: the objection is satisfiable together with the strong premises (finite model) and leaves the conclusion derivable. The Comparator config also verifies the limits of this result: the same objection exposes the weaker reading's gap; the strong premises entail the weak premises and the absolute conclusion entails the relative one, so an objection that falsifies a weaker premise or the relative conclusion would refute the strong form too.
